response.sql: WITH c AS (SELECT p.SEX AS SEX, COUNT(*) AS cnt FROM Examination e JOIN Patient p ON e.ID = p.ID GROUP BY p.SEX), s AS (SELECT SEX, cnt, cnt * 1.0 / SUM(cnt) OVER () AS share, AVG(cnt * 1.0) OVER () AS avg_cnt FROM c) SELECT SUM(cnt) AS total_count, AVG(share) AS avg_share, AVG(cnt - avg_cnt) AS avg_excess FROM s WHERE cnt > avg_cnt

assumptions.assumption: An inner join on ID is used, so examinations without a matching patient are excluded. NULL SEX and empty-string SEX are separate groups, and both count toward the per-sex average and the combined total used for shares.
